verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a Hybrid Deployment model in which customers run a Hybrid Deployment Agent on their own hosts. The docs cover environment-specific configuration parameters and systemd management, and one agent can handle multiple connections. However, agents are still created and managed from the Fivetran dashboard, and the product describes itself as a fully managed platform, so the core product is not fully self-hosted. Missing for 10: a fully self-hostable control plane and dashboard, documented self-hosted install and upgrade of the entire product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
